findings.title: Queries are interpolated twice in the sharding path and the ad hoc filters get duplicated
findings.body: runSplitQuery now calls applyTemplateVariables on every target. runShardSplitQuery already interpolated the targets and then calls runSplitQuery for each sub-request, so each query goes through applyTemplateVariables twice. applyTemplateVariables also applies ad hoc filters (request.filters), so they can be added to the expression twice. Re-running interpolation on an already-interpolated expression can also mangle it, for example by double-escaping or expanding things like `$__auto` or `$__range` a second time. The fix is to interpolate once, at the top-level entry point only.

findings.title: Test asserts a brittle call count that encodes double interpolation
findings.body: The assertion `applyTemplateVariables` toHaveBeenCalledTimes(5) only holds because each sub-request is interpolated again inside runSplitQuery. That is 1 call in runShardSplitQuery plus 4 in the sub-requests. The test therefore locks in the redundant interpolation and will break when it is removed.
